project.description: The meadow round the village, as data: its ground a topographic map, twenty kilometres along its river's valley and ten across, the valley's floor level at the river, the land rising north and south through rolling ground and hills to the moors at its edge, a hill for the church, a hollow for a pond; its river cut into the floor; and its land features over it, its meadows, its moors, its river and its pond. No roads yet.
